title: epan: Add column for number displayed
description:
Add a column for "Number displayed" to fetch value directly
from frame_data. Remove frame.number_displayed because it's
not useful to filter on this value.

notes.body: I haven't tested yet, but I would guess that using this as a filter runs into the same issues as filtering on cumulative bytes or delta time displayed - because the value depends on the result of filtering, it's not idempotent and has unexpected results.
This is true. I will remove frame.number_displayed again, and only use frame_data.dis_num in the column.

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/17556/diffs?diff_id=1141036137&start_sha=2aed2355bcc37ea49d07cf63b1b7af9c1029ed2c#e63cf729943474686d3048af74b42268e9d93994_213_214)

@stigbjorlykke "it would be nice", "it should", "why doesn't ..."  
How to reset the numbering when changing the column that sorting is done on?  
  
![241016_number_displayed_anno](/uploads/d770ef35e938b0a4c5f59decb413b57a/241016_number_displayed_anno.png)  
  
In this case I would like to see 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.
You don't. Basically the same as #3481 for the time delta displayed.

I can understand why it confuses people, but we would really have to rework how the columns and column display works to do that. Those columns are in the same ordering as the Number column, not the sorted order in the GUI.

Thanks for link to #3481.  
Nice to see my brain is consistent w.r.t. "displayed" fields.  :-)
